samples.title: Electricity disconnection SMS
samples.description: Says your power will be cut tonight.
samples.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our electricity officer 9876543210. Thank you.

samples.title: SBI KYC update SMS
samples.description: Account blocked unless you click a link.
samples.description_kn: ಲಿಂಕ್ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ ಖಾತೆ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
samples.text: Dear SBI user, your YONO account will be blocked today. Update your PAN/KYC immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.example/login

samples.title: Part-time job WhatsApp
samples.description: Earn daily by liking YouTube videos.
samples.description_kn: ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಲೈಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ ದಿನವೂ ಗಳಿಸಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
samples.text: Hello! We are hiring for part-time work from home. Earn Rs 3,000 to Rs 8,000 daily by liking YouTube videos. Contact HR on Telegram: https://t.me/demo_hr_desk

samples.description: A drugs parcel and an arrest threat.
samples.text: This is Mumbai Cyber Crime Branch. A parcel in your name containing drugs has been seized by customs. Your Aadhaar is linked to money laundering. Join the video call immediately or an arrest warrant will be issued.
